metaTitle: Custom Box Duffle Gym Bags | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom box duffle gym bags for your team or event. Bulk pricing and free setup from Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Box duffle gym bags offer a structured silhouette that stands up to daily commutes and weekend trips, unlike soft-sided duffles that collapse when empty. With a flat bottom and reinforced sides, these bags hold their shape for easy packing and stacking in team lockers or event storage. Decorate the wide front panel or the zippered end pocket with your logo using screen printing or embroidery for a crisp, professional look that lasts.
heroAltText: Custom box duffle gym bags with embroidered logo, structured shape, and multiple zippered compartments
